headline: The Financial Times says the biggest AI cloud companies are carrying a large amount of borrowing that is not easy to see.
score_reason: Pool 6 lowered by 1: the FT piece could not be opened, so nothing beyond its headline is known.
importance_line: What changed is a new Financial Times piece on how much the largest AI cloud companies owe, which would matter first to savers and pension holders who own their shares and bonds, then to lenders and to the companies themselves, and the doubt is that its figures and evidence, and whether it is reporting or opinion, are not known.
summary: The Financial Times says the hyperscalers, the largest cloud-computing companies building AI data centres, are carrying a huge amount of leverage, meaning borrowing relative to their own funds, that is not obvious.
